notes.title: Pyramid Tits DLC & Easter Events!!!
notes.content:
Happy April 1st everyone! This one is going to be a crazy update for Shady Lewd Kart. As its the day of fools we decided to release some content that was lost and forgotten in the early days of Kart. Pyramid Tits was a lost character from the early concept of Kart that parodies a certain raider of tombs. Well now you can play as her in our first official DLC!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579600/Shady_Lewd_Kart__Pyramid_Tits_Character_Pack/

PT has a full story mode and three unlocks including her damage bubble and panties to collect as well as she is voiced by british babe PixieWillow! So you know its a banger of an update!

Also for your pleasure ALL the Easter Events are back. Every single one! So get out there if you havent and collect those goodies! Lots of characters and lewds to collect!

We also did some polishing of a few things as well as the main loading times for the game so lets see how that feels on your gunked up computer! As always let us know what you think and any bugs keep us informed.

Happy April Fools!

notes.title: Book of Korvald OUT NOW!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2132380/Book_of_Korvald/

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/23168fc4cd830526adb12d799beadc2bc4561bf3.png[/img]

[b]Book of Korvald is OUT NOW on Steam! [/b]Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with a parasitic eldritch entity. Join forces with beautiful warrior nuns, sexy mythical figures and lustful interdimensional creatures to prevent our world from being devoured. Can you contain your sexual urges and fight to survive? 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d3c80a887ca8238abdab5c93b2d5b5898a832691.png[/img]

Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with an eldritch entity named "Qhroth'un".

History does not tell us that Norse clans had scribes of their own. Their folklore is said to have been preserved through oral traditions exclusively, but this is not the truth. Many written sagas were damaging to the reputation of royal families and expository to the church. So these writings, along with their authors, were aggressively purged from existence. Korvald was one such scribe.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/15b48123089c8e96badd36a288b47601ddd51a32.png[/img]
Korvald's is not a tale of heroism and justice, but of deceit and suffering provoked by powerful religious empires and unseen cosmic forces. His story begins as so many are ended. Family slain and taken from his now destroyed village, Korvald is branded as a heretic and seemingly condemned to death. The true purpose of his capture and torment are part of a much bigger and far more sinister agenda. In his darkest hour, Korvald is approached by Qhroth'un and an agreement is made that will change everything...
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/34357d04c1a657d9fa8a369dea66d188a6eb5296.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/b86b29fe922ffe18811ada8f7d7ccd48f640e7ac.png[/img]
- Over 50 different female characters complete with sexual encounters. All raw, hot and fully animated.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/38fd4b2ffa2893f6a86a66601d87132087cb5223.gif[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/08699a9b705e37b3c59df293d8faf0e5f919c4cd.png[/img]

[b]Maps / Environments / Areas:[/b]
- Each chapter takes place across an entire country, spanning over 30 areas. Starting in Denmark near the city of Ribe, drawing inspiration from the conversion to Christianity that took place around the 9th century in Scandinavia.

[b]Weapons:[/b]
- 200+ different weapons to find or buy from various shops. Axes, Swords, Maces, Whips, Spears, Flails, Daggers, Shields, and Books (yes books).

[b]Artifacts:[/b]
- 30+ different artifacts and special off-hand weapons to equip. You could raise the dead Templar knights as zombie minions, inflict plagues on nearby enemies, and even cause certain NPCs (and even some enemies) to strip naked (because... why not?).

[b]Runes:[/b]
- Korvald will discover the true meaning and origin of runes and runestones. Utilizing his unique insight into this powerful language, he will gain the ability to harness many destructive and helpful forces. Unleash flaming cyclones, lightning storms, arctic blizzards, healing waters and even summon eldritch creatures to aid you in combat.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/64388e27ba7f7491195e40dbedc0a6e1437ced41.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2132380/Book_of_Korvald/

notes.title: Update: Version 1.1.1!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

I'm very pleased to announce that the game is not only being updated with a number of additions, improvements & fixes, we're also adding a completely new game branch: [b]Accessibility Mode[/b]!

You can opt in to Accessibility Mode like a beta by right clicking on Daughter of Essence and going to Properties > Betas, and it makes a number of adjustments to the game for people who struggle with the faster QTEs or the difficulty of boss encounters. You may also prefer this version if you are less interested in planning your builds and worrying about stats and would prefer things be a little less challenging.

[i]Note: You can carry over your old save to accessibility mode, but it will not retroactively modify your saved characters' stats. You cannot, however, carry over a save file from accessibility mode to the standard build.[/i]

[b]ACCESSIBILITY MODE FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Doubled base health for Mercy, Orus and Beatrix
[*] All HP recovery items now have higher flat rate increases
[*] Timer doubled on all fishing events
[*] Combat QTEs removed, damage formulae are now flat
[*] Mercy starts with 10 more Attack and Spirit
[*] Earth Vial restores 50% HP on resurrection instead of 30%
[*] Infinite Stat/Skill Respecs Available
[/list]

[b]Version 1.1.1 Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new NSFW scene art (Fort Wilkes scene)
[*] Added new quest areas to the Aster Valley manor 2nd floor
[*] Added two new recruitable NPCs for the cove

[*] Tom will now correctly disappear after the cutscene with him and Marlan (may still repeat once on old saves, however)
[*] Leite will disappear from the Isle of Deer camp site after translating the cave writing
[*] Fixed a passability issue on the Isle of Deer
[*] Liis can no longer wander into the hallway and get stuck
[*] Beatrix base level increased from 10 to 12, and base SP increased from 2500 to 3000
[*] The hunters from Esterholt have had very slightly adjusted stats
[*] Fixed a portrait flicker issue in the Dream Eater fight
[*] Adjusted the positioning of certain enemy battlers
[*] Fixed a passability issue in Grey Clarion
[*] Unyielding Wounds status changed from 8 rounds to 4
[*] Fixed an issue where ending the fight vs. the strangers with 0 HP could result in a game over

notes.title: DoE Update 1.06 (March 23)
notes.content:
Hi everyone, this is the 5th patch since launch and since this one makes a couple of small changes, I thought I'd make a short post.

The walkthrough is updated all the way to the end, and I've made a change to how a couple of passive NSFW scenes trigger. They're now behind choice menus like most other scenes. Beyond that, just a handful of minor bug-fixes. Enjoy!

[b]Version 1.06 - 3-23-2021[/b]
Updated the walkthrough
[list]
[*] A couple of passive NSFW scenes have been placed behind choice menus rather than autoplaying, so they can be avoided if that is your preference
[*] Fixed a move speed error after interacting with the mysterious chest in the cove
[*] Fixed a couple of passability issues at Fort Wilkes
[*] Fixed some text-runoff on the credits screen
[*] Fixed some outdated fishing spots
[*] Fixed a passability issue in Grey Clarion
[*] Fixed a passability issue in Hawk’s Keep
[/list]
